name: planning
purpose: Turn a goal into an approved spec and a list of next tasks, one question at a time.
done: The user approved the spec, and the owner has the list of next tasks.

steps.title: Read the goal and the docs
steps.instructions: Read the brief and the project docs. List the open questions that the docs do not answer.

steps.title: Ask one question
steps.instructions: Ask one open question in the full format: the question, the context, the options and your recommendation.

steps.title: Answer
steps.instructions: The user or the orchestrator answers the question.
steps.exit: the answer is recorded in the store

steps.title: Record the answer
steps.instructions: Write the answer as one decision row in docs/decisions.md. Update the list of open questions.

steps.title: Write the spec
steps.instructions: Write the spec from the answers. Send a report that the spec is ready for review.

messages.when: the spec is ready for review

steps.title: Approve the spec
steps.instructions: The user reviews the spec: approve, change or refuse.

steps.title: Propose the next tasks
steps.instructions: Split the approved spec into tasks. Send the list in a done report to the owner.
